t: Heavy duty DEWALT Tough 8m tape measure designed to provide exceptional durability on any jobsite. A 32mm wide, Mylar-coated, carbon steel ToughBlade offers resistance to abrasion and corrosion, and a rubber-reinforced ABS plastic ToughCase adds protection. An oversized metal impact plate prevents wear, and protects the 3-rivet true zero end hook when dropped. Featuring double-sided print for vertical and overhead measuring, metric and imperial scales for versatile use, and a 4m standout reach for efficient single-person use. Ideal highly accurate measure for professional builders and carpenters. Includes removable magnet for added convenience.
b: Mylar-Coated Steel Blade with 3-Rivet True Zero End Hook
Oversized Metal Impact Plate & Hook Protection
